name: Westerly (United States)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the town seal reading THE TOWN OF WESTERLY, R.I. OFFICIAL SEAL 1669, with three fish on a blue shield.
history: Westerly is a town on the southwestern coastline of Washington County, Rhode Island, first settled by English colonists in 1661, and incorporated as a municipality in 1669.
